title: Navigating a Shifted Sensor Matrix
description: A robotic sensor records telemetry data in a strictly increasing sequence, but a system reboot causes the sequence to rotate at an unknown pivot point. Given this rotated array of distinct integers and a target sensor reading, find the index of the target value. If the target is not present, return -1. Your solution must run in O(log n) time complexity.
constraints: All values in telemetry are unique.
telemetry is guaranteed to be rotated at some pivot.
input_format: An array of integers 'telemetry' and an integer 'target'.
output_format: An integer representing the index of the target, or -1 if not found.

examples.explanation: The target 0 is located at index 4.
The target 3 is not present in the array.
The target 0 is not present in the single-element array.
